values.note: 2025 rate card (still the card posted in October 2026): rustic $20, 30-amp electric (with or without water) $29, 50-amp $31 per night; rustic cabin $45, electric cabin $50 (2-night minimum). Dump $10 for non-campers; water fill $10 per 50 gal. Fall, monthly and seasonal specials by phone. Early arrival / late check-out $5 an hour; additional tent $10 a night.
